buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. NAME OF THE FIRM hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NIL Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: As per Inspection Clause or authorized representative of Ed/OFBH

5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C YANTRA INDIA LIMITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of YANTRA INDIA LIMITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-Qualification Criteria:- 1. Firm should be established /successful supplier for supply of any type of Rubber Item. 2. If the firm is established /successful supplier for any type of Rubber Item at O F Bhusawal need not to su bmit any proof being established /successful supplier. If, the firm is established /successful supply for any t ype of Rubber Item in any PSU/Govt Department or any listed Company in that case firm has to submit sup porting documents in this regard (i.e. Supply Order copy, Tax Invoice/ proof of successful supply/ successf ully execution of Supply Order, Drawings). 3. Firm should be Registered for any of type Rubber Item in any DPSU/ Govt Department. Firm should sub mit the valid Registration Certificate. If firm is not registered then the firm has to apply for Registration at O F Bhusawal within a period of 1 month. 4. The Firm shall have rubber product manufacturing facilities like Mastication, Mixing, Curing , Molding etc .

5. The firm shall have in-house Testing facilities like Shore Hardness, UTS, Impurity, Muffle Furnace etc. 6. Firm shall have qualified experienced team from domain knowledge. 7. Firm shall submit documents in proof of above information mentioned para (2) to (6). 8. Non-compliance of above terms and conditions may result in termination of participation and offer of th e Firm will be liable for rejection. Bids without submission of above supporting documents will be summaril y rejected and no further correspondence in this regard will be done. This may be strictly adhere to. Bidder Undertaking - I have read the clause mentioned in ATC in this bid and given compliance of the following clauses: 1) Specification 2) Drawing 3) Delivery Period 4) Option Clause 5) Inspection Clause 6) Bidder Financial Standing 7) Non-Disclosure Declaration Certificate 8) Non-Involvement in Cartel Formation: We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cartel with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIMIT ED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 9) Material: Pre-inspection report, Guarantee/warranty certificate and Test Certificate should be sent along with supply. The material will be checked by Govt. lab/NABL accredited lab and the results of the lab will b e the sole criteria for acceptance of the item. 10) Loading/Unloading: Offer should be for Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Unloading of Goods at OFBH prem ises will be done by the supplier. 11) Product Delivery: a. Each package/bags shall be suitable marked with identification marking to enable satisfactory reference with the corresponding Invoice and GeM contract number. Marking on Each package/bags must contains r eference Invoice number. GeM contract number, Qty, Item description, Outer dimension, volume and gross weight in Units should as per contract. If identification marking on each package/bags is not available or n ot matching with reference Invoice Qty then firm is responsible delay to acceptance of material or for any short supply. Every Gunny/Plastic/Packaging bag containing the material/component should be sufficient s trength/strong enabling to bear standard way of handling and not to tear easily. b. Supplier must generate Physical Invoice Qty as per Lot wise Qty of stagger delivery period mention in re spective contract. GeM invoice to be generated at time of delivery as per physical invoice Qty within delive ry period. If supplier get any difficulties to generate the GeM Invoice within delivery period then contact to GeM help desk to resolve the issue.

c. Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in 1) Physical Tax Invoice 2) GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty) 3) Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) 4) Guarantee/Warranty 5) Pre-Inspection Report d. In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignment then material will not be taken inside the Factory. 12) Guarantee/Warranty: The stores supplied against the order shall be deemed to have been warranted b y the contractor against deterioration/defective material and workmanship and performance for a period of 12 months from the date of receipt of stores at our end and any material found rejected/defective during t he Guarantee/Warranty period, the same should be replaced free of cost. 13) Payment Terms: Payment terms shall be 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted materia l within 30 days for the date of receipt of material or submission of bills/documents whichever is later. 14) For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procu rement manual. Note: In case any query/information please contact to Provisioning section, Ordnance Factory Bhusawal at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552, 222907, Extn-241 .
